dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ah... the park is one of the most pleasant places in the city.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Most people taking a break there are relaxed and in pretty good spirits, so they're always willing to listen to a song or two.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Eh-he~ let's work together to make this park even more beautiful!
